python3 -c "
from openpyxl import load_workbook
wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=False)
ws = wb['Budget']
cat = {}
for r in range(11, 23):
    cat.setdefault(ws.cell(r,1).value, []).append((ws.cell(r,2).value, ws.cell(r,3).value))
total = sum(v for items in cat.values() for _, v in items)
for c, items in cat.items():
    print(f'{c}: ' + ', '.join(f'{n}={v}' for n, v in items))
print('TOTAL EXPENSES:', total)
print('C23 formula:', ws['C23'].value)
"
